text: Hallelu YAH! Praise YHWH from the heavens; praise Him in the heights!
Praise Him, all His angels; praise Him, all His hosts!
Praise Him, O sun and moon; praise Him, all stars of light!
Praise Him, O heavens of heavens, and waters that [are] above the heavens!
Let them praise the name of YHWH, for He commanded, and they were created.
And He established them for ever to forever; He made a decree, and it shall not pass away.
Praise YHWH from the earth, sea creatures and all the depths;
fire and hail, snow and clouds, wind of storm—doing His word;
mountains and all hills, trees of fruit and all cedars;
the beast and all cattle, the creeping thing and bird of wing;
kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth;
young men and also maidens, old with young:
Let them praise the name of YHWH, for His name alone is exalted; His splendor above the earth and the heavens!
For He has raised up the horn of His people, the praise from all His saints, from the sons of Israel, a people near to Him. Praise YAH!
